articles.title: Mindef to focus on economic empowerment instead of welfare aid for military vets, says Khaled
articles.summary: Malaysia's Defence Ministry is reforming its veteran support strategy, moving beyond solely welfare assistance. The new focus is on long-term employment and economic empowerment for former service members. This aims to provide sustainable livelihoods and integrate veterans into the workforce, ensuring their continued well-being and contribution to society after their military careers, a vital aspect for any armed force.

articles.title: One month into Iran war, some Trump objectives are unfulfilled as he looks to wind down the conflict
articles.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump has outlined five specific objectives the nation aims to achieve before ending its month-old conflict with Iran. This strategic declaration sets clear preconditions for resolving the ongoing 'war', indicating a defined roadmap for de-escalation. The announcement highlights a focused approach to conclude the month-long engagement.

articles.title: DAC clears proposals worth Rs 2.38 lakh crore to augment defence capabilities
articles.summary: The Defence Acquisition Council (DAC), chaired by Raksha Mantri Shri Rajnath Singh, convened on March 27, 2026. This meeting, announced by the Ministry of Defence through PIB, underscores India's ongoing focus on bolstering its defence capabilities. The DAC is pivotal in approving new procurements and policies, crucial for modernizing the armed forces and ensuring national security through strategic defence acquisition decisions.
